name: recvmmsg
synopsis: int recvmmsg(int sockfd, struct mmsghdr *msgvec, unsigned int vlen, int flags, struct timespec *timeout);
description: The recvmmsg() system call extends recvmsg(2) to receive multiple messages from a socket in a single call, improving performance for applications. It also supports a timeout for the operation, allowing blocking or non-blocking behavior.

parameters.name: sockfd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the socket to receive data from.

parameters.name: msgvec
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of mmsghdr structures to store received messages.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags for the operation, including those from recvmsg(2) and additional ones like MSG_WAITFORONE.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure for the timeout period, or NULL for indefinite blocking.

return_value.success: Returns the number of messages received in msgvec
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

bugs: The timeout is checked only after each datagram, potentially causing indefinite blocking if fewer than vlen messages are received in time. Additionally, errors after the first message may not be reported correctly and could be overwritten by unrelated events.
